narrative.overview: The portfolio uses a flat, restrained layout for technical work. Strong headings establish the reading order, a single blue accent identifies actions, and a neutral surface gives project artwork room to stand out. The shell works across both languages and both themes.
keyCharacteristics: Inter for interface text and reading, with system monospace for technical labels.
A shared content column, compact controls, and borders that define where groups begin and end.
rules: Blend the accent toward the regular foreground for the role and internship availability on Home. Use solid text in forced-colors mode.
dos: Do use readable text labels for navigation and pair the current-route color with an underline.
Do pair the accent fill with its theme-specific foreground and reserve the error color for validation or failure.
Do let long copy, labels, and tags wrap within their columns in both English and French.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass effects, neon, or decorative icons to the shell.
Don't make color the only cue for keyboard focus, link purpose, or current navigation.
